experiment: H19-G0 SAMPLE-ONLY; no graph BUILD and no Recall evaluation
data_source: H18-R1 SAME-RUN proposal capture + SIFT1M raw fbin; no R1.2/ H18-C1 data mixed

pre_registration.score_calibration: scores do NOT read holdout pairwise exact distances; evaluated after scoring
pre_registration.budget_definition: sum of full |A|*|B| rectangle pair counts, not actual wall clock

notes: Primary label: directed cross-block pair not in PILOT proposals and closer than PILOT second-nearest proposed neighbor. Surrogate ONLY, not final graph retention or ANN Recall.
Candidate block pairs are a cheap sketch-selected search space plus random controls, not exhaustive all block pairs.
Pilot/holdout split is by leaf. Different leaves can share vertices; source availability in pilot varies.
Some candidate pair distances were likely computed in other leaves without becoming Top-2 proposals. This audit cannot recover all pairwork from proposal logs.
Per-leaf proposal sources reconstruct membership for leaves size>=2; empty/singleton leaf memberships are not recoverable.
Overlap-only/centroid-distance proxies are simple ranking baselines; their failure does not prove novelty of directional proxy.
Same score-based block budget does NOT simulate what happens when baseline leaves are removed (lost candidate edges), or include pilot/packing/scoring wall-time.
Outcomes are correlated samples; no p-values, generalization to other seeds/data, degree/recall or algorithm performance claims.
H19-C1 remains NOT SELECTED even if proxy beats sampled baselines.
